question: Can the claim-1528 label-only Z2 exchange be a genuine non-anomalous symmetry or Ward identity of the completed Pati-Salam operator/source action?

sourceSwapTheorem.conclusion: An off-shell source exchange is a symmetry of the source-coupled action if and only if the operator doublet is exchanged contragrediently. Leaving O_D and O_M fixed does not work.
sourceSwapTheorem.fixedPointBoundary: At k_D=k_M the numerical source is unchanged by P, but this makes the source transformation trivial at that point; it supplies no field transformation, Ward identity, or reason the action must lie there.

typedOperatorAudit.diracOperator: O_D=L_P H nu_P^c on particle-particle Dirac support
typedOperatorAudit.majoranaOperator: O_M=S_-3 nu_P^c nu_N^c on particle-conjugate Majorana support
typedOperatorAudit.importantQualification: After all indices are contracted, each monomial spans an abstract trivial gauge representation, so an untyped Hom between the two one-dimensional singlet lines is nonzero. The vanishing statement is for typed local operator/carrier intertwiners induced by transformations of the fundamental fields while preserving gauge action, grading and J.

exactInternalSymmetry.requirement: a transformation of dynamical fields and measure leaves the fixed-coupling action invariant
exactInternalSymmetry.result: No exchange action exists on the sourced typed fields. Diagonal phases preserving both nonzero monomials do not relate k_D and k_M.
exactInternalSymmetry.status: excluded in the standard local linear symmetry class

spurionicSymmetry.requirement: sources transform contragrediently to a realized operator action
spurionicSymmetry.result: A formal abstract relabelling O_D<->O_M, k_D<->k_M makes k^T O invariant, but the operator exchange has no sourced field/carrier lift. Source swap alone fails B^T A=I.
spurionicSymmetry.status: bookkeeping reparameterization unless a physical operator action is supplied

duality.requirement: an isomorphism of theories maps operator algebras, states, correlators, thresholds and vacua while sending O_D to O_M
duality.result: No such map is present in the corpus; the local typed intertwiner is obstructed. A genuinely nonlocal or strong/weak duality is not logically excluded but must be constructed, not inferred from coefficient equality.
duality.status: open only with new duality data

fixedLocusRestriction.result: defines a one-dimensional subfamily of actions but is not itself a symmetry or Ward identity

anomalyAudit.classicalGate: A quantum anomaly is tested only after a nontrivial classical transformation of dynamical fields has been defined.
anomalyAudit.sourcePermutationJacobian: unit determinant magnitude in a nondynamical two-source coordinate space
anomalyAudit.sourceJacobianMeaning: not an anomaly cancellation result, because external-source relabelling has no fermionic path-integral measure action
anomalyAudit.conclusion: The proposed label Z2 fails before the anomaly question: it is not a classical Ward symmetry of the completed action. It is therefore neither shown anomalous nor shown non-anomalous.

thresholdAndNormalizationAudit.factors: t_D=c_D v_H Z_D and t_M=c_M v_S Z_M, including Clebsches, VEVs, wavefunction and threshold matching
thresholdAndNormalizationAudit.boundary: When t_D differs from t_M the low-energy ray is weighted. Calling P_IR a symmetry inserts the threshold ratio into its generator, exactly the claim-1528 weighted-reflection boundary.

vacuumAudit.condition: A putative exchange must map the full scalar potential and vacuum, not only two interaction coefficients.
vacuumAudit.availableVacua: the Dirac bidoublet and Majorana singlet/triplet dressings are inequivalent and have independently normalized VEVs
vacuumAudit.invariantVacuumDatum: an explicit identity relating c_D v_H Z_D to c_M v_S Z_M

renormalizationAudit.multiplicativeCase: beta_D=gamma_D k_D and beta_M=gamma_M k_M require gamma_D=gamma_M along the line
renormalizationAudit.availableProtection: none, because no realized exchange Ward identity relates the two operator renormalizations
renormalizationAudit.conclusion: The equality locus is not proven radiatively stable. Its preservation is an additional test, not a consequence of the formal source Z2.

assumptions: local invertible symmetry acting on the sourced fundamental fields
preservation of Pati-Salam gauge action, Lorentz type, finite grading and J
off-shell invariance of the source-coupled action
strongestNoGo.theorem: No genuine Z2 Ward symmetry can act as k_D<->k_M. Off-shell invariance forces O_D<->O_M, while the allowed field-induced action on their typed span is block diagonal because the typed intertwiner space vanishes.
strongestNoGo.notExcluded: a new enlarged theory with extra partner fields, a nonlocal duality with a full operator-algebra map, or an ultraviolet relation that ceases to be an exact symmetry after thresholds

reopeningDatum: Supply an explicit transformation of the dynamical field algebra (or a full duality functor) that maps the normalized typed O_D line to O_M, including partner kinetic terms, scalar potential, gauge and family representations, grading, J/CP action, path-integral measure, vacuum/threshold map, and beta-function intertwining. Equivalently enlarge the spectrum so the two portal complexes become isomorphic and then prove anomaly cancellation and RG tangency.
verdict: The claim-1528 label-only Z2 is a useful projection on source space but is not a genuine non-anomalous Ward symmetry of the completed Pati-Salam action. A source exchange requires an operator exchange; no such typed field-induced exchange exists. At the equal-source point the transformation is trivial, thresholds generically turn it into a weighted reflection, and radiative tangency remains unprotected.
